description: The chart represents the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. The pie chart is divided into six slices, representing different emotions. The slices are labeled as Neutral (blue, 23.1%), Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Sadness (orange, 14.7%), Happiness (dark blue, 8.1%), and Excitement (purple, 14.1%). The percentages are displayed inside each slice. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way. The proportions of the slices are easily estimated from the chart.
